doc.title: Nancy Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995

chapter: Coming to New York and signing
title: Parents who were not show business people
summary: Her family never pushed; music was around her from childhood.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: And I was blessed here again. My people were not show business people. They did not push. They wouldn’t have known how. It was, the music was in my face, all the, from the time I was a little kid.
